review.intent_summary: Multi-resolution analysis keeps native finalized subperiod evidence and completed fixed 24-hour aggregates, with a separate marker for the unfinished day.

criteria.criterion: Callers can select sum, mean, or last aggregation for completed and partial periods.
Regular timestamped sub-day samples produce distinct native and completed-period analysis views.
A trailing partial aggregate reports observed progress and links its native evidence while remaining outside the completed-period series.
An explicitly unfinished source sample is excluded from both analysis views.
A source cadence that does not evenly divide 24 hours is rejected.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.

Inspected multi-resolution: separate completed_period/intraday namespaces; trailing 12/24 finalized samples aggregate to 1200 and link 12 intraday evidence records, excluded from completed-period scoring.
